name: Sternoclavicular Joint Dislocation
definition: Dislocation of the sternoclavicular joint, anterior or posterior; posterior dislocation can threaten mediastinal structures.

redFlags.item: Posterior dislocation with dyspnea, dysphagia or vascular symptoms

core: Airway/swallowing assessment when posterior injury suspected

investigations.principle: CT is preferred to define dislocation and mediastinal relationships.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Posterior dislocation requires urgent reduction in an appropriate monitored setting because of mediastinal risk.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Sandhi displacement phenotype may be documented only after emergency modern assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Dislocation of the sternoclavicular joint, anterior or posterior; posterior dislocation can threaten mediastinal structures.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
